metadata.description: Community-maintained Claude Code plugins for SciX (NASA ADS) research workflows.

plugins.name: nasa-ads
plugins.description: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read papers in full, and silently build a classified literature library of layered digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a section map, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Reuse them in research and writing, reread the exact paragraph behind a citation, browse with adslib, and export citations.
